behavior: An item of `Menu` or `Select` does not activate for the release of the trigger press that opened the popup when the release comes within 5 px of the point of the press. The open can put an item under a pointer that does not move: a layout change can move the trigger, and `alignItemWithTrigger` puts the selected item of `Select` there. Base UI activates that item when the release comes 200 ms after the press (`Menu`) or 400 ms after the open (`Select`): the menu runs the action of the item, and the select commits its value and closes. A release more than 5 px from the point of the press still activates the item under it.
